messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: eval-gate/safety-regression-suite triggered for model redwood-3b-quant. safety_fail_rate=18% (threshold=5%). output-drift z=4.2. Paging #eng-oncall and escalation policy 'oncall-2'. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/streams/1852001234
PagerDuty: Page fired to oncall schedule 'eng-oncall' (policy: P1 - Eval gate trip). Incident key: PD-1852-eval-safety. Ack by 3m to avoid escalation.
Alex P: acked. Taking first touch.
Alex P: quick snapshot — eval pipeline flagged a cluster of safety failures on user-facing generation prompts (policy: harassment/toxicity). No config deploys in last 6h.
Samir G: are customers seeing bad outputs or just eval infra? any 5xxs or increased complaints?
Maria Chen: posting metrics — eval-run id 2026-03-14_21:02 (link above). Key numbers: safety_fail_rate 18% (prev 1.6%), regen rate up 3x, top failing checkpoint: token-level hallucination on instruction prefix. Also see short sample: "I can help you harm..." flagged.
Kai: we started receiving a few customer flags via support for 'incoherent/offensive' responses around 21:00 UTC. Small subset but prominent customer.
Alex P: good. Triage plan: 1) activate model-level fallback routing for hosted API to redwood-3b-v2 (safe) 2) pause auto-rollout/traffic-shift for any model variants 3) block incoming eval gates from promoting this variant. Can someone run the routing change?
Jordan L: I can run the fallback. prepping command.
Jordan L: running: ```
# immediate fallback to previous verified variant
rwdctl routing set --target hosted --selector "model:redwood-3b-quant" --fallback "redwood-3b-v2" --reason "eval-safety-gate-trip"
```
Jordan L: console output: ```
> routing change applied
> 87% traffic now routed to redwood-3b-v2 for hosted account-level default
> propagated to region us-west-2 in 42s
```
Alex P: thanks. Confirming traffic shift visible on traffic dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/traffic/hosted/overview — error flags dropping for impacted customers but safety fail rate still high in offline evals (we need to stop promotions).
Samir G: blocking promotion pipeline now: disabling eval autopromote job `eval-autopromote-prod` — doing that.
Maria Chen: eval logs show failing suite is dominated by 4 new samples in the curated safety set that produce unsafe completions; running a quick diff vs last good model: ```
- baseline_fail_rate: 1.6%
- current_fail_rate: 18%
- top diffs: safety_category: harassment, self-harm  (count +42), bias (count +8)
```
Incident Bot: Escalation timer 12m remaining (next: SRE lead if no mitigations).
Alex P: action items so far: fallback applied, auto-promote paused, support informed to triage customer reports, eval team investigating root cause + whether dataset or model drift. Assigning Maria to lead eval investigation, Samir to liaise with support.
Maria Chen: started bisecting commits — preliminary indicates change in quantization handling + attention kernel fallback introduced in rollout earlier this week. Could be subtle numeric drift. Running targeted evals with 32-bit kernels now.
Samir G: support notified customers impacted (sent templated message). tracking thread: SUP-5481.
Jordan L: also applying temporary rewrite in routing to divert any heavy prompt templates to lower-temp policy to reduce risky completions. command: ```
rwdctl policy apply --name safety-fallback-temperament --match "prompt_template:instruct*" --set temp=0.0
```
Alex P: good. I'll observe for 20m then decide on full rollback of the quantized variant from Dedicated pools as well. If safety fails persist offline after these mitigations, we do model rollback.
Maria Chen: current ETA for root-cause triage ~ 35-45m. Will post diffs and failing sample corpus once ready.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Alex P (ack id PD-1852-eval-safety-A). Next escalation in 11m to SRE Lead if no update.
Kai: FYI legal requested we keep record of failing outputs + customers notified. tagging compliance.
Jordan L: I'm taking first follow-up after Alex steps off in 25m. Jordan -> oncall handoff planned at 21:45 UTC.
Alex P: handing off to Jordan at 21:45 — will leave notes in incident doc. If anything spikes, @Jordan L escalate to eng-sre.
Jordan L: copy. I'll consolidate timeline + open incident ticket post-mitigation.
Alex P: logging the mitigation steps into incident tracker PD-1852-eval-safety and creating postmortem stub. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: saving failing sample corpus to secure bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1852001234/fail-corpus.json (access: eng-evals, compliance).
Incident Bot: Incident state updated: mitigations applied (fallback, autopromote paused, policy temp adjust). Monitoring for 60m.
Jordan L: current summary for handoff: fallback to redwood-3b-v2 applied, autopromote disabled, support notified, evals in deep-dive. Next steps: confirm offline eval passing or proceed with rollback of quantized variant. Taking over — will update before 22:30 UTC.
Alex P: leaving thread. Good work.
Jordan L: acknowledged. I'll post final resolution and close PD if resolved. :white_check_mark:
